declarations.comment: The new sentence - 'A runtime error signaling the use of an uninitialized variable or value.' - is clean: no self-reference, declarative present-tense voice, good standalone summary, not redundant with the signature. One structural nit: the file now has two Scaladoc comments for this class - the pre-existing one at line 17 ('This class represents uninitialized variable/value errors.') and the new one at line 21. Scaladoc tools use the comment immediately preceding the declaration (line 21), leaving the line-17 comment as an orphan. Since the TODO was already positioned at line 21, the writer correctly filled it in; but ideally the line-17 comment would have been removed to leave a single, canonical doc block.
